title: Rain-Night Metro Ascent
teaches: Turn one reusable collider-owning primitive stair assembly into a cinematic rainy metro exit without introducing scene-specific DSL tags.
Share existing wet concrete, plaster, weathered concrete and brushed-metal PBR textures across station architecture and street dressing.
Combine transparent puddle planes, low-roughness paving, drains and water-stained walls to communicate recent rainfall.
Keep one kinematic Character 1 walking continuously from the underground floor to the upper street collider across three camera cuts.

Use matched deterministic stair-synchronised Camera3D position and target keys with camera-local Camera3D.hiddenBones hips-root exclusion, then restore the full character in later shots while retaining animation, collision and shadows throughout.
Create deterministic near, middle and far world-space rain with Repeat mode=volume while retaining only a faint screen-space lens layer.
Simulate a passing vehicle-light sweep using timed intensity curves across multiple supported SpotLight nodes.
Build the matching passing vehicle from a reusable CompoundAsset and animate its parent Model along the wet road.
Replace an oversized roof slab with a short landing canopy assembled from fascia, beams, columns, gutter, downpipes, wall caps and a layered station sign.
Render a readable Welcome to Anica Station sign from full-UV artwork derived from the shared official Anica logo instead of placeholder primitive glyphs.
Bloom only the official Anica logo, composite sharp station wording afterwards, and drive 3D emission from a separate logo-only mask.
Turn the entrance into a believable building opening with a structural portal, façade joints, service door, utility box, poster glazing and interior shelf silhouettes.
Create city depth with storefront glazing, awnings, framed façades and recessed dark/warm/cool window modules that separate wet glass from deeper interiors.
Add tactile paving, slab seams, a patterned manhole, hydrant, bin and street sign as non-colliding human-scale street detail.
Map two project-local readable poster artworks onto double-sided full-UV planes inside glazed, non-colliding display frames.
Layer three seeded 3D rain volumes with animated canopy runoff, puddle ripples and splash markers without adding particle-specific DSL tags.
Reuse compact alpha sprites for expanding rain rings, compound splash crowns and slowly drifting glass rivulets while keeping all weather dressing non-colliding.
Add deep skyline masses, sparse window strips, drain-side leaves, paper scraps, sticker residue, repair patches and wall scratches without introducing scene-specific tags.
Reduce wet-stair normal frequency and specular peaks while preserving deliberate puddle and passing-vehicle reflections.
Use MaterialAsset transmission, IOR, optical thickness and attenuation for framed architectural glass while automatic transparent depth behavior preserves the Character GLB behind it.
Balance cool HDR and moon light with cyan, magenta and amber practicals before ACES, bloom and film-grain finishing.
